To get access to all features, you need to log in as an Android TV device.

Follow these steps:
• Copy the code shown on the web page.
• Press the "Next" button at the bottom.
• Enter the code and press "Activate".
• Press "Authorize".

You can log in using an external browser.

Follow these steps:
• Press "Open URL" to open the login page.
• Login to your account and press "Authorize".
• A page with an error should appear. Copy the URL of that page, paste the URL into the box below and press "OK".

To get access to all features, you need to log in as an Android TV device.

Follow these steps:
• Copy the code shown on the screen.
• Press the "Open URL" button.
• Enter the code and press "Activate".
• Press "Authorize".
• Return to Xtra and press "Next".
